Browns vs Steelers Betting History

The Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers have met 117 times since the 1966 season. The Steelers lead the series 75-41-1. Against the closing spread the Browns are 57-57-3 (Steelers 57-57-3), and the over is 40-50-1 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Dec 28, 2025, Browns 13-6.
